value.title: Known NGW failure causes reach only human-readable owned UI text
value.statement: Preserve positively classified account IO and server Parse without changing producer counters. Export/read only exact local result owner and captured counts in a fresh private pass Bundle; never forward that metadata/body/Throwable/URL to Intent or storage. Pure SERVER alone uses shared possible-maintenance/overload copy; current offline wins at consumption. Mixed, late, auth/rights/local/untrusted/malformed reports stay safe generic. Final noncancel child failure of a previously clean project must not become silent success; keep per-target failure state, report once after cleanup and preserve normal cancel. Child-list failed response differs from successful empty list. LayerFill allows only typed known cause or owned human copy, never infers403 from JSON shape. Legacy list Toast uses actual resource IDs. Text is not durable ACK.
